claims.text: The resort is an oceanfront hideaway overlooking the white-sand beaches of the Riviera Maya, off the beaten path.

findings.quote: Off the beaten path, an oceanfront hideaway beckons, overlooking the white-sand beaches of the Riviera Maya.

claims.text: The resort is about 30 minutes from Tulum.

findings.quote: Guests are about 30 minutes away from Tulum

claims.text: Ancient ruins, natural wonders and other Riviera Maya attractions are within a half-hour's drive.

findings.quote: Find ancient ruins, natural wonders, and endless Riviera Maya attractions within a half-hour’s drive.

claims.text: There are cenotes and hiking trails in the area, and the hotel can help guests access them.

findings.quote: There are also cenotes in the area as well as hiking trails which the hotel can help you access as well.

claims.text: The Conrad is the more intimate, higher-end property within a larger Hilton complex on the coast.

findings.quote: It's the more intimate and high-end property for the Hilton complex on the coast

claims.text: The franchise rights were sold to a Mexican couple, which may explain the resort's mix of brand amenities and local touches.

findings.quote: they sold the franchise rights to a Mexican couple which may explain why this resort does such a good job of marrying the bells and whistles you'd expect of the brand with local touches

claims.text: Rooms have large white beds, hand-painted artworks that echo the colors outside, and rattan chandeliers.

findings.quote: with large white beds, hand-painted art works that pull in from the palette outside, and rattan chandeliers

claims.text: The spa has treatment casitas and offers a four-hands traditional Mayan massage.

findings.quote: The treatment casitas were extremely relaxing.
I opted for a four hands traditional Mayan massage

claims.text: The team is made up of local workers at all levels of the business.

findings.quote: pulling together a team of local workers at all levels of the business

claims.text: There are nine places to eat.

findings.quote: There are nine different places to eat

claims.text: Autor is the resort's fine Mexican dining venue.

findings.quote: Autor, the fine Mexican dining venue

claims.text: Self-parking and valet parking are available for guests with vehicles.

findings.quote: Self-parking and valet parking are available for guests with vehicles.

claims.text: The spa's central lounge is designed like a cenote, with sunlight coming through a large opening in the dome.

findings.quote: The central lounge is designed like a cenote, with sunlight flooding in through a huge opening in the dome

claims.text: Ocean-facing rooms have hot tubs built into the balconies.

findings.quote: Ocean-facing rooms have hot tubs built into the balconies

claims.text: Wooden entrance doors pivot open onto a breezy lobby with a layered water view: ornamental pools, then the main central pool, then the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: Lumbering wooden doors are pivoted open to reveal the breezy hotel lobby and create a view with layers of water, first the still ornamental pools, then the main central pool and finally the glowing Caribbean sea.

claims.text: The spa is built from local natural rock and timber.

findings.quote: constructed from natural rock and timbers in the area

claims.text: Rooms are spread across three blocks, each with its own central pool with a pool bar and full service.

findings.quote: rooms are spread across three different blocks, each block with their own central pool with pool bar and full service

claims.text: Reaching the main pool involves the lobby steps, which is less convenient with a stroller; there are lower-level rooms with accessible showers.

findings.quote: I struggled getting my stroller up and down the lobby steps to get to the main pool
There are lower-level rooms with accessible showers.

claims.text: The resort is about 30 minutes from Tulum, and Tulum International Airport is about 65 km (40.6 miles) away.

findings.quote: Guests are about 30 minutes away from Tulum
The nearest airport, Tulum International Airport (TQO), is 40.6 miles (65 km) away

claims.text: The Conrad is part of a larger Hilton complex on the coast rather than a standalone property.

findings.quote: It's the more intimate and high-end property for the Hilton complex on the coast
